        items = res.get('success', [])
    else:
        items = res
    if not items:
        break

    page_index += 1

current_year = datetime.now().year
recs = all_recs
print('current_year', current_year, 'num_recs', len(recs))
# Filter by classical and release_date year
import re

def year_from_release_date(rd):
    if rd is None:
        return None
    # Expect ISO string
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{4})', rd)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None

filtered = []
for rec in recs:
    sid = rec['song_id']
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = details.get('genre')
    rd = details.get('release_date')
    y = year_from_release_date(rd)
    if genre and str(genre).lower() == 'classical' and y == current_year:
        filtered.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': details.get('title'), 'genre': genre, 'release_date': rd, 'album_id': details.get('album_id'), 'album_title': details.get('album_title')})

print('filtered_count', len(filtered))
print('filtered_song_ids', [x['song_id'] for x in filtered])
print('filtered_first', filtered[:5])

# Create new playlist named 'Spotify Recommended Songs'
playlist_title = 'Spotify Recommended Songs'
create_res = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=access_token, is_public=False)
print(create_res)
playlist_id = create_res.get('playlist_id')
print('playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Add filtered classical songs released this year
song_ids_to_add = [x['song_id'] for x in filtered]
print('song_ids_to_add', song_ids_to_add)
add_results = []
for sid in song_ids_to_add:
    r = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    add_results.append((sid, r))
print('add_results', add_results)

# Verify playlist contents
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
print('playlist_title', pl.get('title'))
print('playlist_song_ids', [s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])])
# Some API might label songs with 'song_id' instead of 'id'
if not pl.get('songs'):
    print('no songs field returned')
else:
    ids_alt = [s.get('song_id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])]
    if any(x is not None for x in ids_alt):
        print('playlist_song_ids_alt', ids_alt)
